items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the face clean without adding to any dryness or irritation.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and comfort, which suits the lower moisture score.
A mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection and is gentle on skin showing some redness.

response.routine_note: Use the cleanser and moisturizer morning and night, with sunscreen last each morning. Since three months of chemist products haven't changed how your skin looks, please book a visit with a dermatologist or doctor rather than adding more products from a shop.
